name: Ferienwohnung Dr. Höss
beschreibung:
Idylllically and sunnily situated on a hillside in Thiersee, Ferienwohnung Dr. Hoess provides upscale living comfort. The expansive apartment features stylish interiors, modern amenities, and a private balcony overlooking the mountains.

Lake Thiersee is just a short walk away, while hiking routes ascending Mount Pendling and winter snow sports begin nearby.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Dr. Hoess in Thiersee offers peaceful relaxation close to the lake in sunny Kufsteinerland.
